label.description: A data/text key (for example "crop.carrot"), never player text: the viewer resolves it through TextTable (ADR 052).

seed_item.description: The items.json id a sow of this crop consumes.

sow_job.description: The jobs.json kind that sows this crop: its effects consume seed_item and set the first stage (checked on load). A farm zone of this crop submits it.

harvest_job.description: The jobs.json kind that harvests this crop: its effects require the last stage and yield the produce (checked on load). Submitted on every ripe tile of this crop.

window.description: The calendar window id the crop grows in (and a farm zone sows in). A calendar without it (a scenario's) leaves the crop no season: it never grows and an unripe one withers.

grow_days.description: In-window days from sown to ripe.

stages.description: tiles.json ids from sown to ripe, reached at even fractions of grow_days; the first is the tile sow sets, the last the tile harvest requires.

wither_days_after_window.description: Days after the window's last day at which an unripe crop withers.

withered_tile.description: The tiles.json id a withered crop leaves.
